cards.b: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip suffered a vault drain of $4.86 million to $12 million due to a suspected key compromise allowing a valid signature withdrawal. The team offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return the remaining funds.

cards.t: Cyber Protocol Suspends Transfers After Bridge Exploit
cards.b: South Korean exchanges including Upbit, Bithumb, and others halted CYBER deposits and withdrawals following an unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana and tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox.

per.CYBER: Transfers halted across multiple South Korean exchanges amid bridge exploit investigations.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Total funds lost in the exploit and timeline for resuming bridge operations.
